history.heading: Prescriptions
history.questionText: To ask the Secretary of State for Health and Social Care, what assessment she has made of delays and errors in the administration of repeat prescriptions.
history.answeringBodyName: Department of Health and Social Care

history.questionText: To ask the Secretary of State for Health and Social Care, what steps she is taking to help the NHS prepare for the winter.
history.answeringBodyName: Department of Health and Social Care

history.questionText: To ask the Secretary of State for the Home Department, will she take steps to allow non-EU nationals to undertake voluntary work without a work permit.
history.answeringBodyName: Home Office
